_doc: TTS abbreviation lexicon (precis.draft.verbalize). letters: spelled out letter by letter. words: read as a word, value is the respelling the synthesizer gets. expand: replaced by the spoken phrase (matched case-sensitively, trailing dots included). Unknown all-caps tokens of 2-6 letters default to letters; mixed-case tokens and chemical formulas are never touched. Plain data so the phonetics DB can share it.
